geometry_review.openings: PASS — court-facing doors, paired windows, glazing depth, frames, and PTAC units are physical and attached

geometry_review.site_contacts: PASS — court, walks, apron, parking lines, wheel stops, building volumes, and pylon reach grade
geometry_review.rear_and_sides: PASS — blank striped right outer wall follows the source; rear and side walls have physical board-and-batten relief and service glazing

discrepancy_ledger.finding: rear roof carrier dominated the model; parking lines were rotated; office sign clipped; pylon obscured the architecture
discrepancy_ledger.resolution: shortened side roof carriers, lowered rear roof, corrected stall orientation, moved sign text, and reframed cameras

discrepancy_ledger.finding: roof and court finishes were visually flat and the hero omitted the identity-bearing pylon
discrepancy_ledger.resolution: added source-derived material provenance and widened/rebalanced the hero composition

discrepancy_ledger.finding: photographic crops tiled visibly and made the roof read as woven fabric
discrepancy_ledger.resolution: forbade photo projection and replaced it with source-calibrated procedural microstructure

discrepancy_ledger.finding: rear oblique exposed overly dark triangular roof-junction pockets
discrepancy_ledger.resolution: added explicit physical triangular prisms sealing both valley/gable junctions

non_blocking_observations: Rear-oblique gable and valley faces remain dark under neutral QA lighting, but the on-disk model contains physical closure prisms and no open void at either junction.
required_next_task: Independent reviewer must compare the authoritative catalogue images, locked reference, and v5 render set and record approval before keeper promotion.
